snippet.title: Psalm 30 (God/Good/Faithful)
snippet.description:
'Psalm 30' is part of the 'The Psalms of Summer' worship collective

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives!

We pray that these songs help usher you into a deeper connection with God through His Holy Spirit.

Lyrics:

When all hope was gone
And the lights went out
And I wept all through the night
I cried out for mercy
“Oh God can You hear me?”

When I felt the weight
As it crippled me
And depression took its hold
I cried out for mercy
“Oh God can You hear me?”

You lifted me on high
Brought me triumph in the night
And turned my wailing into praise
Your anger passed me by
But Your favor is for life
Your love for me never fails

I know You hear me when I cry
Your hope will last all through the night
I know that You are always near
You are God You are good
You are faithful

What can stop my heart
From singing praise
Like a choir in my soul
I testify of mercy
And I give You all the glory

You life me higher and higher
So I’ll lift You higher and higher
We’ll lift you higher and higher

You lifted me on high
Brought me triumph in the night
And turned my wailing into praise
Oh God of grace and mercy
I give thanks for how You’ve healed me
Oh God of grace and mercy
I give You all the glory

snippet.title: Psalm 34 (When I See Your Face)
snippet.description:
'Psalm 34' is part of the Jubilee Church 'The Psalms of Summer' worship collective

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives!

We pray that these songs help usher you into a deeper connection with God through His Holy Spirit.

Lyrics:

I’ve been remembering the way things were 
Ever since I was a child 
Shame was constant 
Always by my side 
I believed I was reviled 

I cried many lonely tears
Pinned down by all my fears

I hid my face 
Ooos

Even when I thought I cried alone 
There was someone listening all along
He heard this poor girl cry and pulled me in 
I never felt so warm
 
He said you’re not alone 
Come, let me hold you close

Let me see your face
Ooos

Now the one that I hid from 
Is the one that I run to
The one that I run to
Now the shame that hid my face
Is turned into glory
Turned into glory
(When I see your face)
Ooos

Even before I knew You 
Even before I could say Your name 
You were planning my days
And You don’t fail 
No, You don’t make mistakes
You turn shame into praise
And you are always making a way 

For me to lift my face

snippet.title: Psalm 1 - (Ever Blessed)
snippet.description:
'Psalm 1' (Ever-Blessed) is part of the Jubilee Church 'The Psalms of Summer' worship collective

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives and we rejoice over what He has done for us!!!

We pray that these songs help usher you into a deeper connection with God and remind you that you are 'Ever-Blessed', not by works, but by the grace of God!

Lyrics
I was walking on the road of the wicked
I was standing in the door of sin
I was sitting in the seat of the skeptic
I was dust in the wind

I was living on the far side of judgement
Had no hope and no defense
No purpose and no direction
I was lost in the wilderness

You set me on the path of blessing
On a road marked by faithfulness
Though I stumble I will keep confessing
That I’m walking in Your goodness

I’m ever-blessed
I'm ever-prosperous
My soul’s at rest
Cause I’m walking with the Lord

Though the way of the Lord is narrow
And few stay on it for life
Heaven waits for those who finish
For glory will be their prize

snippet.title: Psalm 78 - (No Slave)
snippet.description:
'Psalm 78' (No Slave) is part of the Jubilee Church 'The Psalms of Summer' worship collective

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives and we rejoice over what He has done for us!!!

We pray that these songs help usher you into a deeper connection with God. 

Lyrics:

I squandered Your wealth and spent what You gave
I racked up a debt I couldn't repay
A cross was reserved at the top was my name
Now all that is left is a crimson blood stain

I am no slave in the house of God
I am Your child 

My shame was a weight and each sin a chain
If I had to carry just one I’d break
Thought I'd be the last person You'd want to save
Then I saw You running and calling my name

And when liars speak then I'll say it plain
Jesus is mine our fate is the same
I'm loved by the Father He knows my name
I've been forgiven freed by His grace

I'm not an orphan
I'm not a failure
I'm not forgotten
I'm loved by the Lord

snippet.title: Psalm 23 - (Dwell In Your House)
snippet.description:
'Psalm 23' (Dwell In Your House) is the 5th installment in the Jubilee Church 'The Psalms of Summer' worship collective

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives and we rejoice over what He has done for us!!!

Let this song remind us of God's presence in our lives, His faithfulness, provision, safety and love! 

Lyrics:

All my days secure in Your promise
Every breath inhaling Your grace
Every moment hemmed in Your faithfulness
And today I rest in this

You prepare a table before me
In the presence of my enemies
Surely goodness and mercy will follow me
All my days through heaven’s gates

I will dwell in Your house Lord forever
I will dwell in Your house Lord forever
Where wanting will cease
And my joy is complete
I will dwell in Your house Oh Lord

Though I walk through valleys of shadows
I will fear no evil around
You are near Your kindness restores my soul
You will lead me to rivers of peace

In Your presence
My cup overflows
In Your presence
My soul will rejoice
Your life-giving presence
Is right where I want to stay
For all my days

snippet.title: Psalm 51 - (Joy Again)
snippet.description:
'Psalm 51' (Shame Into Joy) is the 6th installment in the Jubilee Church 'The Psalms of Summer' worship collective

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives and we rejoice over what He has done for us!!!

Let this song remind us of God's presence in our lives! We sing Hallelujah for His goodness and joy everlasting. Our hearts cannot contain this praise!!!!

Lyrics

I am desperate
I am broken
Full of regret
Of grief and heartache

All I have done
You have seen it
Everything lay
Bare before you

But this I know to be true
You take my heart shattered and bruised

Full of mercy
Bringing healing
Waves of love and
Seas of compassion

Fountains of grace
Joy everlasting
Changing my future
Turning my mourning to dancing

And this will always be true
That my spirit has been renewed.

You have washed all my sins away
Your mercy comes like a flood each day
You’ve created in me a heart that is bursting with praise
I will sing of Your joy again

Unlock my lips to sing
My shame has turned to joy
My heart cannot contain
The praises of my God

snippet.title: Psalm 67 (Let the People Sing)
snippet.description:
'Psalm 67' is the 9th and final addition to the Jubilee Church the 'Psalms of Summer' worship collective!

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives and we rejoice over what He has done for us!!!

We are reminded as we worship that we serve a God who deserves our highest praise. As we turn away from our sin, we turn to the One who saves!

Lyrics

Come all who thirst for Him
Come and drink your fill 
God’s in this place
Search while He can be found
Seek the One who saves
He is the Lord

Let the people sing His praise
Every heart give endless thanks
For the Lord our God is good to all He's made
Break the silence with a song
Til the whole earth sings along
For the Lord our God deserves the highest praise

Turn from Your sins and trust
In the One who died
And rose again
Call on Him while He's near
Then tell the world 
He is the Lord

Let all of the nations praise Him
Let the earth be glad and sing
Songs of joy and hope  
‘Til all come worship Him
